newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fiat to launch Punto model in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Fiat to launch Punto model in Japan.

text.p: Fiat Auto Japan KK, the Japanese unit of Fiat SpA, said on Tuesday it would begin marketing its Punto compact car series in Japan.
The new 1,240cc Punto Selecta and Punto Cabrio Selecta will go on sale on March 1 with a sales target of 2,500 Punto Selecta and 500 Punto Cabrio Selecta.
The domestic selling price will be 1.885 million yen for Punto Selecta and 2.45 million for Punto Cabrio Selecta.
The Punto models will be right-hand-drive and will be equipped with Electro-Continuously Variable Transmission (ECVT), which provides smoother driving and better fuel efficiency.
